description: How whogothacked.com verifies records, which sources it reads, how many records it holds and when each source was last read: the data's coverage and freshness. Records are verified from regulator filings and Have I Been Pwned; a threat actor's claim is never a source. A miss means there is no record here, not that no breach happened. Counts from different sources are not additive.
name: about_data
title: About the data
